Interface IBufferedDrawable

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

Interface for osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawables which can be drawn by a osu.Framework.Graphics.BufferedDrawNode.

public interface IBufferedDrawable : ITexturedShaderDrawable, IDrawable, ITransformable

Properties

BackgroundColour

The background colour of the osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IFrameBuffers. Visually changes the colour which rendered alpha is blended against.

Color4 BackgroundColour { get; }

Property Value

Color4

Remarks

This should generally be transparent-black or transparent-white, but can also be used to colourise the background colour of the osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IFrameBuffer with non-transparent colours.

FrameBufferDrawColour

The colour with which the osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IFrameBuffers are rendered to the screen. A null value implies the osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IFrameBuffers should be drawn as they are.

DrawColourInfo? FrameBufferDrawColour { get; }

Property Value

DrawColourInfo?

FrameBufferScale

The scale of the osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IFrameBuffers drawn relative to the size of this osu.Framework.Graphics.IBufferedDrawable.

Vector2 FrameBufferScale { get; }

Property Value

Vector2

Remarks

The contents of the osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IFrameBuffers are populated at this scale, however the scale of osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawables remains unaffected.
